policies.outbound:
<set-variable name="responseBody" value="@(context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true))" />
        
        <set-variable name="usageData" value="@{
            try {
                var body = JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["responseBody"]);
                var usage = body["usage"];
                var choices = body["choices"];
                return new JObject(
                    new JProperty("promptTokens", usage?["prompt_tokens"]?.Value() ?? 0),
                    new JProperty("completionTokens", usage?["completion_tokens"]?.Value() ?? 0),
                    new JProperty("totalTokens", usage?["total_tokens"]?.Value() ?? 0),
                    new JProperty("model", body["model"]?.ToString() ?? "unknown"),
                    new JProperty("finishReason", choices?.FirstOrDefault()?["finish_reason"]?.ToString() ?? "unknown"),
                    new JProperty("choicesCount", choices?.Count() ?? 0)
                ).ToString();
            } catch {
                return new JObject(new JProperty("parseError", true)).ToString();
            }
        }" />
        
        
        @{
            return new JObject(
                new JProperty("eventType", "ai_prompt_response"),
                new JProperty("userId", (string)context.Variables["userId"]),
                new JProperty("userEmail", (string)context.Variables["userEmail"]),
                new JProperty("timestamp", DateTime.UtcNow.ToString("o")),
                new JProperty("operationId", context.RequestId),
                new JProperty("usage", JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["usageData"])),
                new JProperty("responseTimeMs", context.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds),
                new JProperty("statusCode", context.Response.StatusCode)
            ).ToString();
        }
        
        
            @{
                return new JObject(
                    new JProperty("event", "ai_request_completed"),
                    new JProperty("userId", (string)context.Variables["userId"]),
                    new JProperty("operationId", context.RequestId),
                    new JProperty("usage", JObject.Parse((string)context.Variables["usageData"])),
                    new JProperty("responseTimeMs", context.Elapsed.TotalMilliseconds)
                ).ToString();
            }
